VERSION_REGRESSION_REMOVED: Present in an older official fixture but absent from current fixture; mathematical reason must be recovered by version replay.
UPSTREAM_LIST_REJECTED: A curve from an external/older candidate list is explicitly rejected by current theorem criteria.
LALG_V2_MISMATCH: 2-adic valuation of algebraic L-value does not match branch requirement.
EPRIME_2TORSION_MISMATCH: 2-isogenous quotient E' has the wrong rational 2-torsion structure.
SQUARE_CONDITION_FAILED: One of the required nonsquare quantities is actually a rational square.
S_EMPTY: Required set S is empty under deterministic criterion / confirmed search.
POSITIVE_ANALYTIC_SHA_V2_UNRESOLVED: Positive predicted 2-adic Sha valuation requires higher 2-power descent; current safe gate rejects.
DESCENT_TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN: A descent backend timed out; treat as unknown, never as theorem failure.
TEST_FLAG_UNSOUND: Run used a testing flag that skips a theorem condition; output is not theorem-qualified.
GCD_3N_HARDENED: Twist filter requires gcd(d,3N)=1; older/looser logic may differ.
SEMANTIC_VERSION_DRIFT: Paper pseudocode and current repository implementation differ in proof-strength or output semantics.
